chose: move the rules classifiers into @buttery/food/classify
over: leaving them in services/pipeline/src/workflows/recipe-enrichment/lib/classifiers/
because: food already owns the domain vocabulary and the classifiers are pure functions over it. Measured three duplicated spellings across the boundary: AllergenSlug (identical 10-string union in food/src/traits.ts:19 and pipeline types.ts:69), TriState (traits.ts:16 and types.ts:21), and IngredientTraits vs FoodTraits — the last declared structurally on purpose so a classifier would not depend on where traits come from, a reason that evaporates once the classifier lives in the same package as the traits

chose: autoload works directly on .ts files under node's native TS stripping — no build step, no compiled-dir indirection needed
because: throwaway spike: @fastify/autoload registered against a dir with one fp-wrapped .ts plugin, run via 'node src/_spike/run.ts' (no build step, Node 26 native TS type-stripping), app.ready() resolved and the decorator was present

chose: implemented Phase 1 and Phase 2 as one pass, verified once at the end

because: the plan's own phase split is interdependent: D4 (fastify.db inside workflow steps) requires fastify in scope inside index.ts/steps.ts, which only exists once those modules become plugins (D6, filed under Phase 2). Honoring the split would mean inventing a throwaway singleton-getter shim in Phase 1 just to delete it in Phase 2 — more churn than value. Converted db/redis/posthog/ai plugins and the workflow plugins together, single typecheck+test pass at the end

chose: capture.ts split: only AI_GENERATION_EVENT + Usage/Pricing/Error types + envFloat moved to lib/ai/capture.ts

chose: plugins/ai.ts owns the memoized Prompts client; lib/ai/prompt-fetch.ts is a pure function taking client+promptName+fallbackText

The memoized Prompts client and the warn-once flag are lifecycle state, so they belong in the plugin closure (fastify.ai.fetchPrompt), not in lib/. Updated prompt-fetch.test.ts to call the pure fn directly with an explicit client instead of resetPromptCache()

because: D4 makes db.ts/posthog.ts each own their own onClose; recipeEnrichment's close (closeDb+shutdownPosthog) and atprotoSync's close (closeDb) become redundant once those pools are the shared fastify.db, and a dead field left in the type is worse than deleting it

chose: slice the migration additively: write all plugins unused first, then the workflow plugin, then convert workflows one at a time, then app.ts+autoload last

chose: delete WorkflowSpec.close from the kernel — measured 2 implementations, 2 call sites, all four pure resource teardown

chose: PostHog prompt management belongs to plugins/posthog.ts, not plugins/ai.ts

Plugin owns construction+lifecycle, lib keeps the pure fetch as a function of its args (D0) — user confirmed plugins calling lib is fine
